G54b_hour_of_day.source: Quantpedia 'Are There Seasonal Intraday or Overnight Anomalies in Bitcoin?' (Gemini 2015-2022): best hours 21:00-23:00 UTC
G54b_hour_of_day.rule: long from 21:00 to 23:00 UTC every day; (i) BTC only, (ii) equal-weight 10 majors; OKX perps hourly
G54b_hour_of_day.costs: 5.5 bp per side (Bybit taker) primary; 2 bp per side (maker) secondary
G54b_hour_of_day.pass_rule: net Sharpe >= 1.0 at 5.5 bp on 2023-01..2026-10 (out of their sample) AND positive 2020-2022
